rules.title: Welcome!
rules.subtitle: Hotel information and guidelines to make your stay even more relaxing.

gastronomy.name: Breakfast
gastronomy.info: Served in the Restaurant from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

gastronomy.name: Executive Lunch
gastronomy.info: Served Monday to Thursday from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

gastronomy.name: Friday Moqueca
gastronomy.info: On Fridays from 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM.

gastronomy.name: Saturday Feijoada
gastronomy.info: On Saturdays from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

gastronomy.name: Italian Sunday
gastronomy.info: On Sundays from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

gastronomy.name: 24h Room Service
gastronomy.info: Menu on the QR Code next to the minibar. Extension 258 or 257.

gastronomy.name: Piano Bar
gastronomy.info: Open daily from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

leisure.name: Pool
leisure.info: Available from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Towels are also available at Reception for your convenience.
leisure.obs: Towels must be returned to Reception by 8:00 PM the same day.

leisure.name: Ecological Trail and Pier
leisure.info: Open from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Ecological trail with stairs leading to an exclusive pier with a view of Vitória Bay. The pier connects to Curva da Jurema, near Shopping Vitória.

leisure.name: Sauna and Gym
leisure.info: Located on the 1st floor, accessible by elevator. Gym: 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Sauna: 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM.
leisure.obs: Please ask reception to turn on the sauna 30 minutes in advance.

leisure.name: Tennis Court
leisure.info: Check availability and booking with Reception.

rules.receptionDescription: We're available to assist you. Reachable at extensions 250 or 251.
rules.wifiDescription: Connect to the Senac network, click on GUEST and follow the access instructions.

housekeeping.name: Room cleaning
housekeeping.obs: If you'd rather not have your room cleaned, please use the Do Not Disturb sign.

housekeeping.name: Laundry
housekeeping.info: Please request pickup by 10:00 AM. Fill out the laundry slip, indicate the type of service and place the clothes inside the designated bag. Available Monday to Saturday (except holidays). An iron and ironing board are available at reception.

rules.extrasDescription: Payment can be made at time of service or at check-out (for the latter, a credit card must be registered at reception). Minibar consumption will be settled at check-out.
rules.noSmokingDescription: A fee equivalent to one night at the standard rate will apply in case of non-compliance.
rules.farewell1: We wish you a wonderful stay,
rules.farewell2: Hotel Senac Ilha do Boi Team
